issue_context.title: In `scan_parquet()`, `include_file_paths` returns twice the same column
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl

# need to create the folders "data/b=1" and "data/b=2" first
pl.DataFrame({"a": [1]}).write_parquet("data/b=1/data.parquet")
pl.DataFrame({"a": [2]}).write_parquet("data/b=2/data.parquet")

pl.scan_parquet("data", include_file_paths="file_paths").collect()
```


### Log output

```shell
shape: (2, 4)
┌─────┬─────┬───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┐
│ a   ┆ b   ┆ file_paths            ┆ file_paths            │
│ --- ┆ --- ┆ ---                   ┆ ---                   │
│ i64 ┆ i64 ┆ str                   ┆ str                   │
╞═════╪═════╪═══════════════════════╪═══════════════════════╡
│ 1   ┆ 1   ┆ data\b=1\data.parquet ┆ data\b=1\data.parquet │
│ 2   ┆ 2   ┆ data\b=2\data.parquet ┆ data\b=2\data.parquet │
└─────┴─────┴───────────────────────┴───────────────────────┘
```


### Issue description

If  `include_file_paths` is specified, it includes the same column twice.

### Expected behavior

The output should contain only one column with the file paths.

### Installed versions

<details>

```
--------Version info---------
Polars:               1.5.0 
Index type:           UInt32
Platform:             Windows-10-10.0.19045-SP0

```

</details>

@kyle-gilde It was in the [1.6.0 release](https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/releases/tag/py-1.6.0).

Testing the example above on 1.8.2 I get the expected output:

```
shape: (2, 3)
┌─────┬─────┬───────────────────────┐
│ a   ┆ b   ┆ file_paths            │
│ --- ┆ --- ┆ ---                   │
│ i64 ┆ i64 ┆ str                   │
╞═════╪═════╪═══════════════════════╡
│ 1   ┆ 1   ┆ data/b=1/data.parquet │
│ 2   ┆ 2   ┆ data/b=2/data.parquet │
└─────┴─────┴───────────────────────┘
```
